verdict.rationale: gstack has a dedicated 'skillify' skill that codifies a script/skill from observed intent (gstack-docs-9), and domain-skills docs describe agents writing per-site notes as skills, promoting them to global scope, and reviewing/pruning learned skills (gstack-docs-10, gstack-docs-11, gstack-docs-26). This shows the project has a meta-skill/spec for an agent to author and package new skills end to end, but the evidence doesn't show a full worked template or explicit packaging/export format walkthrough. missing for 10: a concrete skill-authoring template/spec file shown in full, independent hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully created and packaged a new skill via skillify.
